panels.sample_scope: Fig. 5 | Radial structure of humidity contrasts and the subsequent moisture budget. a, Temporary-minus-final contrasts in pre-event 700 hPa observed humidity, seasonal background and anomaly. Each diagram uses the actual 100, 300 and 800 km radii; uniform colour within a ring represents its saved annular mean, without resolving finer radial or azimuthal structure. b, Contrasts in the 0–24 h integrals of horizontal advection, vertical advection, the residual and moving-frame tendency for the same two annuli. The residual offsets part of the positive inner-annulus vertical-advection contrast. The budget terms retain their diagnostic accounting relationship. Colours and numbers show means; Table S5e reports all original 95% intervals and supports: 117 paired cyclones for pre-event state and 105 for the budget. Table S6b separately reports the matched 80-pair comparison.
